name: crosslg-benchmark-sm
description: A small-scale cross-lingual benchmark intended to measure model performance on tasks that require transferring understanding across languages. It provides compact evaluation suites for quick comparison of multilingual and cross-lingual capabilities on classification and QA-style tasks. The benchmark is designed for fast evaluation of smaller models and research prototypes.
reputation: A lightweight, small benchmark used by researchers for rapid cross-lingual checks and model probing.
